citation: Government Notice No. 153 of 2004 — The Forest Regulations, 2004 (made under s. 106(1) of the Forest Act, No. 14 of 2002)
renumberingNote: Cites s. 106(1) as printed at publication (Act No. 14 of 2002 numbering). In Cap. 323 R.E. 2023 the regulation-making power appears at s. 107 (see card a107). The as-printed citation is kept; it is not modernised.
commencementNote: Regulation 1 provides that the Regulations come into operation on the date of their publication; recorded as publication-based but the commencement date itself is not separately asserted.
signature: Zakia Hamdani Meghji, Minister for Natural Resources and Tourism, Dar es Salaam, April 2004
